title: Variant Gatekeeper and Signalization: Compatibility Matrix Update
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Add a gatekeeper layer and signalization pipeline to the fallback model variant compatibility matrix so routing policies can rely on an automated, scored compatibility signal (tokenizer/context/tooling parity) before issuing fallbacks. The work creates automation to detect regressions, surface drift, and prevent unsafe fallbacks in serving and routing pipelines.
background: We continue to see edge cases where fallback variants differ in tokenizer behavior or KV context semantics, causing downstream errors or significant quality regressions when smart routing falls back across tiers/regions. Existing compatibility checks are manual, brittle, and not surfaced as a unified signal to the routing layer. This ticket defines and implements a Gatekeeper service that emits a compatibility score and flags for each variant pair and wires that into routing decisions and rollout playbooks.
objective: Deliver an automated compatibility gate that: 1) computes a compatibility score per variant pair (tokenizer parity, context window behavior, tooling feature parity); 2) produces actionable flags (unsafe-tokenizer, kv-semantic-drift, tooling-mismatch); 3) ships telemetry dashboards and alerting; 4) integrates the score into smart routing policies so only variants meeting thresholds can be used as fallbacks.
scope: Design compatibility scoring, implement lightweight Gatekeeper microservice, add daily batch and on-demand checks, create routing policy integration (API + config), dashboards and alerting, update runbooks and rollout canary configs.
out_of_scope: Full re-tokenization or model conversion tooling, major tokenizer rewrites, long-running migration of existing cached KV blobs — these are separate follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper service deployed to staging and exposes compatibility API (GET /v1/compat/score?src=<>&dst=<>)
Compatibility score consists of tokenizer_parity, kv_semantics_score, tooling_feature_coverage and an overall_pass boolean
Smart routing policy respects overall_pass flag and fails open/closed per config when score unavailable
Daily batch job identifies variant pairs that drop below threshold and creates a ticket/alert
Dashboards show historical score trends and top failing pairs; pager alerts for sudden drops
Docs and runbook updated with remediation steps and rollback guidance
tasks: Spec: finalize scoring rubric and thresholds (tokenizer tests, sample prompts, KV probes)
Infra: provision staging Gatekeeper service and S3 storage for test vectors
Implementation: scoring pipeline for tokenizer parity using sample prompt set and byte-level checks
Implementation: KV semantics smoke tests (prefix/prefix-eviction, restore, cache-compat)
Routing: add gating call to routing decision path and config flag for fail-open behavior
Telemetry: build dashboards in Grafana and create alert rules in PagerDuty
QA: run compatibility sweep across 25 high-traffic model pairs and validate results
Docs: update Console rollout docs and internal playbook with gate guidance
notes: We should reuse existing tokenizer sample suites (contrib: infra/tests/tokenizer-suite) to avoid duplication
Initial thresholds conservative: require tokenizer_parity >= 0.98 and kv_semantics_score >= 0.95 for automatic fallback
Plan supports manual override in emergency and paired rollout mode for A/B canaries
